@graph.howPerformed: After a consultation and skin assessment, local anesthesia is applied for comfort. Threads are then carefully inserted into the targeted areas using fine needles, and a typical session lasts 30–60 minutes. Before treatment, avoid alcohol and blood-thinning medications for 48 hours, and share your medical history with your dermatologist.

acceptedAnswer.text: Local anesthesia is used, so most patients feel minimal discomfort during the procedure.

mainEntity.name: How long do the results last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results vary with the threads used and your skin, but typically last 12–24 months.

mainEntity.name: What care is needed after a thread lift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid strenuous activity, facial massages and excessive facial movement for 1–2 weeks. Cold compresses can help reduce swelling.

mainEntity.name: Are thread lifts suitable for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thread lifts suit most skin types. Your dermatologist assesses your skin and tailors the procedure accordingly.
